format: vaultody response envelope and typed errors, v1

hierarchy.VaultodyError: the base of every error the SDK raises on purpose
hierarchy.ApiError: VaultodyError; an answer the SDK can't return as a result: status, code, message, details, requestId, apiVersion, replayed, retryable

rules.success: A 2xx JSON object with data.item is an item; with data.items an array, a page: offset-paged when data has offset or total, else cursor-paged. Unknown fields are ignored. Anything else on a 2xx is an ApiError without a code.
rules.error: Any other status is an error. code is error.code when it is a string, else null; message likewise; requestId and apiVersion from the top level when strings, else null; details passed on as given (only when present).
rules.class: The class of the code (RequestSigningError for the key-pair and nonce codes, api_nonce_reused included, AuthenticationError for the four documented 401 codes, InvalidRequestError for the 409 validation codes, DuplicateTransferError for double_spending), else the class of the status: 400, 415, 422 InvalidRequestError; 401 AuthenticationError; 403 PermissionDeniedError; 404 NotFoundError; 409 ConflictError; 429 RateLimitError; 5xx ServerError; anything else ApiError.
rules.replayed: x-api-replayed exactly "true" (header name in any case)
rules.retryable: true only for address_derivation_conflict and vault_accounts_creation_failed, which the docs say to retry at once
rules.branchOnCode: Callers branch on code, never on message.

caseFormat.expected: { kind: item|page, ... } or { kind: error, class, code, message, requestId, apiVersion, replayed, retryable, details? }

sdkErrors.rule: Errors the SDK raises with no answer of the API. Each class extends VaultodyError and is exported where ApiError is: the Node package root, the vaultody_sdk package root, PHP's Vaultody\Sdk\Exception namespace. Each case raises one for real and names the class and the fields it must carry (Python names them in snake_case; these are one word). Nothing is sent: the params are checked before.

caseFormat.call: a method of the client: its group, operationId (Python: snake_case) and params, as the application passes them
caseFormat.expected: { class, fields }: the class raised and the value of each field named

cases.name: param_unknown
cases.description: A param the operation does not document: param names it.

cases.name: param_not_documented_value
cases.description: A value outside the documented list (case included).

cases.name: param_nested_wrong_type
cases.description: A nested field of the wrong type: param is its path.

cases.name: param_nested_unknown
cases.description: A nested field the API does not document.

cases.name: param_nested_missing
cases.description: A required nested field left out.

cases.name: webhook_mismatch
cases.description: A delivery whose body changed after signing.
